name: Fighter Player Jump
instruction: Add the player's jump action to the existing fighter controls. Update `res://scenes/characters/character.gd` so the player can enter a jump sequence from normal grounded movement, rise off the ground, fall back down, and return to the regular grounded state after landing. Use the existing `on_takeoff_complete` and `on_land_complete` callbacks from the starter character script as the completion callbacks for the jump sequence. Update `res://scenes/characters/player.tscn` to add `takeoff`, `jump`, and `land` animations that use the appropriate frames from the 7th row of `res://assets/art/characters/player.png`: `land` should use the 1st valid frame in that row, `takeoff` should use the 2nd, and `jump` should use the 3rd. The task should infer the frame indices from the spritesheet layout. The `takeoff` animation must call `on_takeoff_complete`, and the `land` animation must call `on_land_complete`. The `land` animation must also include a `DamageEmitter.monitoring` property track that disables monitoring while that animation plays. The jump must visibly lift `CharacterSprite` upward during the airborne phase and bring it back to its grounded position when the jump finishes.

metadata.tutorial_source: YouTube: The GameDev Tavern - Create a Beat 'em up game in Godot! (Part 04/20: Enemies)
